rules: Retain endpoint arrays, separating sets via package snapshot, p/value matrices, lag and CI-test settings
LPCMCI conditioning-order cap is computationally bounded search, not full oracle completeness
No learned graph is certified as true from test non-rejection
Effect sensitivity uses separately supplied contemporaneous order alternatives and fresh data; it is not a confidence set
Hidden-common-cause regime has no qualified scalar causal-effect output
Economic variable labels describe a synthetic mechanism, not an identified bank model

effect_sensitivity.target: additive innovation in deposit-price equation to balances, fixed unit impulse
effect_sensitivity.scope: Alternative-model sensitivity, not graph confidence or a post-selection interval
